attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Changes core shape caching key/logic used across all themes/modules (single 'main' cache context per shape type with fallback to dictionary), and shape-morphing scenarios where a shape type changes after Cache() was called could behave differently than before, so subtle regressions in cache hit/miss behavior for existing sites are plausible despite added tests."}

reason: Changes core shape caching key/logic used across all themes/modules (single 'main' cache context per shape type with fallback to dictionary), and shape-morphing scenarios where a shape type changes after Cache() was called could behave differently than before, so subtle regressions in cache hit/miss behavior for existing sites are plausible despite added tests.
